title: Provision verifier aliases mutable rollback state across trust and persistence hooks
description: Timing security review: ProvisionVerifier validates a caller-supplied ProvisionRollbackState then stores that exact frozen-by-convention object in `__rollback`. `object.__setattr__` can lower its record_version after construction, allowing a signed intermediate version to overwrite a higher durable rollback floor. New candidate objects are also passed to `persist_rollback_state` and then stored internally, so the persistence hook can retain and mutate verifier state after returning. Detach authenticated rollback state into private primitive snapshots, pass a separate persistence value, and revalidate durability generation before commit. Add caller mutation before install, persistence-hook mutation after return, digest or encoded-record mutation, lower-version rejection, and reboot tests.
